title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Open redirect on invalid form submission in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.3,…
description: An open redirect vulnerability exists in the Visforms Joomla extension versions 1.0.0 through 5.6.3 and 6.0.0 through 6.2.0. The vulnerability occurs because the 'return' parameter on invalid form submissions is not properly validated, allowing attackers to redirect users to external sites.
